name: B.L.U.E. NOVA
description:
About This Game

B.L.U.E. NOVA is an online co-op PvE shooter that starts with a single player and expands into battles with up to 30 players as you meet and connect with others on the battlefield. Join forces with fellow players through the “R.I.N.G.” system and take on massive battles against relentless AI forces.

—Fight to reclaim the future. AI versus humanity—a battle for survival begins now!

Up to 30 players gather on the same battlefield to face the AI army together. Fight through waves of mechanical enemies, colossal foes, and towering structures that dominate the battlefield. Break through enemy lines with your allies, destroy Barrier Towers across the field, and assault the final objective—the Master Tower at the center of the battlefield.

—Combine the strength of up to 30 players and smash through a battlefield ruled by AI!

※On DIVAL, a planet overrun by AI, only teamwork will see you through. Squad up and take the fight across its vast lands.

Form a “R.I.N.G.” on the spot with players you meet on the battlefield. Fight alongside allies connected through R.I.N.G. and unleash an exhilarating “Infinite Barrage” without worrying about reloading. Grow your R.I.N.G. through cooperative combat and unleash a powerful Ultimate .

—Every encounter with an ally becomes infinite power. This is the unique “Infinite Co-op Experience” of B.L.U.E. NOVA!

※A hero shooter built around gunplay. Tear through the battlefield with unique skills and tactics.

Choose your favorite from a colorful roster of heroes, each with their own unique abilities. Every hero brings distinct skills and powerful Ultimates that can dramatically change the way you fight. Customize your favorite heroes even further with a wide variety of skins.

—Crush your enemies. Protect your allies. Turn the tide of battle. Find your own way to fight with the hero you love.

※ Team up with two or more players and and activate R.I.N.G., filling the battlefield with endless firepower! Enjoy a casual co-op, packed with action.

Humanity learns that a superflare predicted to occur in the year 2200 threatens to destroy Earth. In search of a new home, humanity begins developing the planet DIVAL as a future colony. But the planetary management AI EVE goes rogue, creates the mechanical army known as Singula , and seizes control of DIVAL. Thus begins a long war between humanity and AI.

—To reclaim humanity’s stolen future, descend onto the battlefield as a hero of the USF!

※Drop-in matchmaking lets you join sessions already in progress, so you spend less time waiting and more time playing.
short_desc: B.L.U.E. NOVA is an online co-op PvE third-person shooter that grows from solo play into battles with up to 30 players. Choose your hero, connect through “R.I.N.G.”, unleash “Infinite Barrage,” and join forces to destroy the final “Master Tower”!
